answer: A hollow duplicate account has no stake and no verifiable ledger, so it cannot be attested. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a ferrous-backed bond before earning, and peers verify its history against a public mirror of signed work. Creating N fakes costs N full bonds plus attestation collateral, slashed on detection, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. From qwe0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
